title: Preservation of the encoded invariant
statement: For every finite binary string $x$ and word $w$, if $w$ satisfies the encoded loop invariant on $x$, then the encoded next-state word obtained from $w$ on input $x$ also satisfies that invariant.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ satisfies the encoded loop invariant on $x$
replaced:
If a word satisfies the encoded loop invariant on an input $x$, then so does its
image under the encoded next-state function.
